criteria.assessment: Selected test detail retains source, related work, assertions and recorded execution context.

integration.assessment: The accepted test-panel case exercises the selected test surface.

criteria.assessment: Execution outcomes and unavailable timestamps remain explicit; no completion is fabricated.

integration.assessment: The selected test case checks failure output and unavailable metadata.

criteria.assessment: Technical identifiers are collapsed, explained and actionable.

integration.assessment: The debug case checks collapsed initial state and identifier explanation.

tests.assertion_assessment: The selected test case passes with source, result, failure and related-work detail.
tests.counterexample: Dropping selected source or result context removes the asserted detail.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: The candidate-bound red run has valid behavior failure and final green passes.

tests.assertion_assessment: The debug case passes with collapsed technical details and distinct snapshot/Git explanations.
tests.counterexample: Expanding debug data by default or conflating digest and commit violates the assertions.
